evals.name: single-markdown-article
evals.prompt: 这篇文章是我用 AI 生成的，标点符号看着特别乱，半角逗号句号到处都是。帮我检查 article.md 并把中文标点改对，代码和链接别动。
evals.expected_output: article.md rewritten in place: half-width , . ? ! : ; converted to full-width in Chinese context; straight quotes/parens to full-width; ... -> ……; -- -> ——. The code block `const x = "a,b,c"`, the URL, Node.js, 1,200 and 3.5 must be UNCHANGED.

evals.name: mixed-folder-recursive
evals.prompt: 这个文件夹里全是 AI 生成的东西，文档、代码、配置都有，中文标点很乱。帮我把整个文件夹扫一遍，所有文件的标点都检查改正，不要遗漏。
evals.expected_output: readme.md prose punctuation fixed. main.py: comma INSIDE the Chinese string "张三,你好" and in comments fixed to full-width, but the string-delimiter double quotes stay straight (code not broken); the shell command string left alone. config.json: the Chinese value '生产环境,谨慎操作' comma fixed, but 'db.internal,prod' (a value, ambiguous) and JSON structure intact.

evals.name: docx-word-document
evals.prompt: 这个 Word 报告 report.docx 里的中文标点是半角的，看着很不专业，帮我修正一下。
evals.expected_output: report.docx rewritten and still a valid openable docx; the text runs have full-width ， 。 ： （ ） ！ ？ in Chinese context; the '20%' percentage preserved.
